construct_environment_workers: construct environment workers from a DictConfig with multiprocessing context and worker queues for parallel RL training
create_worker_configs: create per-environment configs by splitting scenes across workers with shuffled scene assignments and unique seeds
build_action_plugin: build a DefaultActionPlugin that clips continuous actions or converts discrete actions from the policy action space
start_experience_collection: start experience collection on an EnvironmentWorker by sending initial observations and episode IDs to the inference queue
run_environment_worker_process: run an EnvironmentWorkerProcess that steps the environment with actions from transfer buffers and reports episode ends
